question: Which of the following dance forms is popular in Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
the correct option is__** Nati.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nati dance** is the most famous folk dance in** Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• A group of people performs it with accompanying musicians.
 
• **Thora **is the famous tribal dance of** Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The dress of the dance group reflects the **gaddi or the Himachali nomads.**

 
 

 States
 Popular dance forms
 
 
 
 

 Meghalaya
 
 
 
• Laho Dance is a folk dance of Meghalaya.
 
• The tribal communities gather in groups to celebrate these festivals.
 
 
 
 

 Himachal Pradesh
 
 
 
• ***Thoda ***is a Warrior dance performed by the Rajputs in the districts of Sirmour, Shimla and Solan of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It is performed during the Vishu Fair in the month of Chaitra and Vaisakh (April-May).
 
• It traces its origin from Mahabharata and it manifests a subtle confluence of dance, sports and folk theatre.
 
 
 
 

 Kashmir
 
 
 
• Rouf dance form is practised on festive occasions like Eid and Ramzan days are going.
 
• It is performed by a group of women standing face to face with each other but the most notable feature of this dance form is the footwork of the dancers.
 
• It is a dance performed on a set during the spring season.
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• Don't be confused between the Thoda and Thora dances. They are different and both of them have been explained above.
